headline: ảc jumps into ARC-2 gold places as Lashen Learning drops out

sections.text: ảc moved from 17th to 13th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board, gaining 2.36 points to reach 71.53 and taking a place in the gold places.
Lashen Learning fell from 16th to 18th at 69.44, unchanged, and is now outside the gold places. The gold line, the score of the last gold place, stands at 69.72.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
